{{Quote|Dead. My lovely Chell, dead. It p-pulled him to pieces! He's fuh-free, wuh-wuh-w...|Chokla's final words|<ref name="TPE" />}}
'''Chokla''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Five]], a small evil-worshipping cult that lived within the remote section of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] known as the [[Hellhoop/Legends|Hellhoop]]. Chokla and her compatriots spent [[Standard year/Legends|centuries]] [[Torture/Legends|torturing]] and [[Death/Legends|killing]] visitors to the Hellhoop&mdash;notably, the Five captured and [[Prison/Legends|imprisoned]] [[Wutzek]], the last known living [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Demon/Legends|demon]]. Sometime between [[0 ABY/Legends|0]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Chokla&mdash;who was romantically involved with fellow Five member [[Chell (human)|Chell]]&mdash;and her group captured [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] leaders [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], preparing to kill them for their amusement as they had so many wayward travelers. However, Chewbacca managed to release Wutzek from its prison, and the demon responded in kind by slaughtering every member of the Five. Chokla witnessed the gruesome death of her lover Chell, before being killed herself.<ref name="TPE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chokla appeared in ''[[The Pandora Effect]]'', a [[1981]] comic story written by [[Alan Moore]] and published in [[The Empire Strikes Back Monthly 151|''The Empire Strikes Back Monthly'' 151]]. In the story, Chokla was drawn by [[Adolfo Buylla]].<ref name="TPE" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'' mistakenly states [[Wutzek]] (misspelled as "Wuzzek"), killed all of the Five but Chokla, while in the comic Wutzek kills every member of the Five.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|32|Hellhoop}}</ref>
